{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Space traffic control sensors were disrupted by lawa flow and volcanic ash, and Ee could have easily lifted off without being noticed.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>}}
'''Space traffic control sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] used to monitor departing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on the<ref name="Files" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Tujiamoor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tujiamoor system/Legends|Tujiamoor system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Tujiamoor]]<ref name="Files" /> around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Date">"[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," which mentions [[Realspace/Legends|space]] traffic control [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], is set "shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which is dated to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Space traffic control sensors were created for the article "[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in the [[August]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]].<ref name="Files" />
